7013562826bb.d: May 13, 2027Eight world class acrobats and one live musician investigate physical skill; how we obtain it, how we perfect it, and how it can transform our lives. Through highlighting the nuance of high-level acrobatics, audiences experience a heightened appreciation of the countless hours required to master the skills they are witnessing. Ten Thousand Hours is a revelry of the distinct physical language that defines Gravity & Other Myths and a celebration of the pursuit of mastery.
